map.输入化妆品类型和检测参数，按《化妆品监督管理条例》评估备案合规性: Enter the cosmetic type and test parameters to assess filing compliance per the Cosmetic Supervision and Administration Regulation.
map.📖 查看「注册（备案/检验/安全评估）流程 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Registration (Filing / Testing / Safety Assessment) Process User Guide"
map.本工具按《化妆品安全技术规范》等公开限值，对输入的重金属（铅/汞/砷/镉）、甲醇: This tool compares each entered test value for heavy metals (lead/mercury/arsenic/cadmium), methanol and microbes against public limits such as the Safety and Technical Standards for Cosmetics, and judges whether each item meets the standard; it runs entirely client-side with no data upload.
map.📚 深度解析：注册（备案/检验/安全评估）流程: 📚 Deep Dive: Registration (Filing / Testing / Safety Assessment) Process
map.备案前自查：把第三方检验报告里的铅、砷、汞、甲醇与菌落总数录进来，先判断这批配方: Pre-filing self-check: enter the lead, arsenic, mercury, methanol and total plate count from the third-party test report to see whether this batch of formula can pass filing.
map.配方微调：某项卡在限值边缘时，先算清各项余量再改配方与工艺，避免反复送检。: Formula fine-tuning: when an item sits at the limit edge, first work out the margin of each item before changing the formula and process, to avoid repeated testing.
map.特殊/普通分流：按类别换用不同菌落总数限值，看清该走 NMPA 注册还是备案流程: Special vs ordinary routing: switch the total plate count limit by category to see whether NMPA registration or filing applies.
map.可复现算例：普通化妆品五项全达标: Reproducible example: all five items of an ordinary cosmetic meet the standard
map.输入：类别=普通化妆品，铅 5、砷 2、汞 0.5、甲醇 0.1、菌落总数 10: Input: category = ordinary cosmetic; lead 5, arsenic 2, mercury 0.5, methanol 0.1, total plate count 100. Built-in limits: lead ≤10, arsenic ≤4, mercury ≤1, methanol ≤0.2, total plate count (ordinary) ≤1000. Item-by-item judgment 5/5 all ✓ → conclusion 'Meets filing/registration requirements'; note that ordinary cosmetics can be marketed after filing on the NMPA platform. If the category is switched to 'special cosmetics', the total plate count limit tightens to ≤500, while the other four limits stay unchanged.
map.可复现算例：汞超标被拦下: Reproducible example: excess mercury is blocked
map.输入：汞 1.5（限值 ≤1）→ 该项判定 ✗，整体结论「不符合要求」，页面提示: Input: mercury 1.5 (limit ≤1) → this item is judged ✗, overall conclusion 'Does not meet requirements'; the page warns of an exceeding item and that the product may not be sold, and the formula or process must be adjusted and retested to pass before filing/registration.
map.限值是从哪里来的？可以改吗？: Where do the limits come from? Can they be changed?
map.按《化妆品安全技术规范》《化妆品监督管理条例》及 GB 7918、GB 7917: The limits are built into the page from public standards such as the Safety and Technical Standards for Cosmetics, the Cosmetic Supervision and Administration Regulation, and GB 7918, GB 7917 (lead ≤10, arsenic ≤4, mercury ≤1, methanol ≤0.2, total plate count ordinary ≤1000 / special ≤500, in mg/kg; total plate count in CFU/g). The tool runs client-side, offline, with no data upload, so the limits are a fixed reference; when regulations update, the official latest text prevails.
map.特殊化妆品和普通化妆品的差别在哪里？: Where is the difference between special and ordinary cosmetics?
map.本工具里主要体现在两点：一是菌落总数限值（特殊 ≤500，普通 ≤1000）；二: In this tool it shows mainly in two points: one is the total plate count limit (special ≤500, ordinary ≤1000); the other is the market path - special cosmetics (hair dye, perming, spot-whitening, sunscreen, anti-hair-loss, new-claim etc.) must apply for NMPA registration with an approval cycle of about 6-12 months, while ordinary cosmetics only need filing on the NMPA platform and can be marketed after filing.
map.能替代第三方检验或官方审评吗？: Can it replace third-party testing or official review?
map.不能。本工具只做「录入值 vs 公开限值」的逐项对照，用于送检前的自查与配方预判: No. This tool only does an item-by-item comparison of 'entered values vs public limits' for pre-test self-check and formula pre-judgment; the legal conclusion must be based on the test report from a qualified laboratory and the review result of the drug regulator.
map.特殊化妆品需NMPA注册（防晒/染发/烫发/祛斑美白/染发等），普通化妆品需备案: Special cosmetics require NMPA registration (sunscreen/hair dye/perming/spot-whitening etc.); ordinary cosmetics require filing
map.重金属限值：铅≤10mg/kg，砷≤4mg/kg，汞≤1mg/kg: Heavy-metal limits: lead ≤10 mg/kg, arsenic ≤4 mg/kg, mercury ≤1 mg/kg
map.菌落总数：特殊化妆品≤500CFU/g，普通≤1000CFU/g: Total plate count: special cosmetics ≤500 CFU/g, ordinary ≤1000 CFU/g
map.备案/注册前需完成产品检验和安全评估报告: Product testing and safety assessment report must be completed before filing/registration
map.化妆品注册备案合规评估工具，输入重金属、甲醇、微生物等检测值，按法规标准判定备案: Cosmetic registration-filing compliance assessment tool: enter test values for heavy metals, methanol, microbes etc. and judge filing/registration compliance against regulatory standards.
